_doc: Un portrait de chef par peuple : 4 expressions (neutre, cri, blessé, sourire). Générés directement dans la couleur du peuple (pas de recoloration). `regard` : sens du visage (Koush regarde à gauche, comme le prévoit le jeu, apps/game/src/drawn/assets.ts).
expressions: Shouting a battle cry, mouth wide open.

koush.chef: the King of Kush, a Nubian warrior king in his forties
koush.design: Short dark curly hair with a team-color headband and a thin gold circlet, short neat beard, gold broad collar, gold earrings, a team-color cape on the shoulders.

carthage.chef: a Carthaginian general in his forties
carthage.design: Rounded gold helmet with cheek guards and a team-color crest, short dark beard, gold scale armor on the shoulders, a team-color cape.

kemet.chef: a general of ancient Egypt (Kemet) in his forties
kemet.design: Striped headcloth in team color and cream, clean-shaven, kohl-lined eyes, gold broad collar, white linen on the shoulders under a team-color sash.

aksoum.chef: the King of Aksum, an Ethiopian king in his forties
aksoum.design: Short dark curly hair with a gold crown band, short beard, white cotton cloak with a team-color woven border on the shoulders, a simple gold disc pendant.
